description: This file is an implementation of the BankingService interface for a banking application. It provides CRUD operations for customers, accounts, and transactions, including account transfers, and interacts with repositories and helper classes. It is a core component managing business logic related to banking transactions and customer data.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of BankingService interface, providing core banking operations such as customer management, account handling, fund transfer, and transaction retrieval, using Spring annotations for dependency injection and transaction management.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customers and converts them to domain objects.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the repository.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds a customer by their customer number.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds an account by its account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a given customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Transfers funds between accounts for a customer, handling all related transaction records.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history for a specific account.
